title: A geometric characterization of the Maz'ya-Shaposhnikova limit on metric measure spaces
summary: We provide a purely geometric necessary and sufficient condition, in terms of a certain Cesàro mean of the volume function, for the existence of the Maz'ya-Shaposhnikova functional limit with respect to Gagliardo seminorms on metric measure spaces (under a mild measure condition). As an application, we establish the Maz'ya-Shaposhnikova convergence on the unbounded Sierpiński gasket. We also show that Ahlfors regularity does not imply the existence of this functional limit by constructing a concrete example.
